:::{#def-graph}
#### Graph of a function

The **graph** of a [function](#def-function) $f : A \to B$
is the set of ordered pairs $(a, f(a))$, one for each element $a$ of its domain:

$$\set{(a, f(a)) : a \in A}$$

For a function $f : \reals \to \reals$,
the graph is a curve in the plane,
with $a$ on the horizontal axis and $f(a)$ on the vertical axis.

:::
